feature: Marketing site route re-registration (Git #1080) — restored Monitoring/Quick-Start Packs + full pre-#382 route list reachable, not 404
notes: Git #1080. Monitoring.tsx and Products.tsx (Quick-Start Packs) were fully deleted in 4c9ebfd3
and restored from 8224d2e7a. #382 had separately unregistered a wider route list from App.tsx
while leaving the page files on disk. This build re-registers all of it: /assessments + variants,
unregistered (deferred to #1088) and are NOT asserted here.
Each step below asserts the route's own real static h1 copy renders (proves the SPA matched the
route and mounted the real page, not the 404 fallback whose own h1 reads 'This page took a long
lunch break.'). Routes with slug-dependent or otherwise non-static h1 content (/assessments,
— their h1 text is data-driven (zone.label / service.tagline / link status) and can't be asserted
against a fixed string without also depending on live catalog/link data; documenting that honestly
rather than faking a check. Only representative service/retainer children (one each) are spot-
checked rather than all 8/3 — the routing mechanism is identical for the rest.
Deployed-origin caveat (same class as #1058/#1059/#1087 prior rows): this manifest asserts against
{{DEPLOY_URL}}, which only reflects this commit once the marketing site is redeployed.
